value.rationale: The proposed low-rank inducing regularizer generically does not reduce exact rank on the simplest centered convex matrix problem; all nonzero singular values equalize at a positive floor, with a sharp exceptional set and a singular gradient-stepsize resonance. This exact phase diagram and objective error quantify a concrete difference between un-clipped polar subtraction and genuine proximal thresholding; it is a natural algorithmic reliability benchmark rather than a mere scalar iteration observation.
